journey.name: signin expected pubky
journey.description: Verifies that a grant sign-in link naming the pubky that must approve it (spk) opens the authorization sheet only when it names this wallet's pubky, is refused with a message naming the other pubky otherwise, and is invalid when spk is repeated or malformed. Precondition: an unlocked regtest wallet with a locally managed Pubky identity. The links are local-only dummy requests and nothing is authorized; never tap Authorize. BASE is pubkyauth://signin_grant?caps=/pub/locks.app/:rw&relay=https%3A%2F%2Fhttprelay.pubky.app%2Finbox%2F&secret=e3t7e3t7e3t7e3t7e3t7e3t7e3t7e3t7e3t7e3t7e3s&cid=locks.test&cpk=5jsjx1o6fzu6aeeo697r3i5rx15zq41kikcye8wtwdqm4nb4tryo and OTHER is 8um71us3fyw6h8wbcxb5ar3rwusy1a6u49956ikzojg3gcwd1dty. Android opens each link with adb shell "am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d '<link>' to.bitkit.dev" and reads toasts from a screenshot; iOS opens the same query through bitkit://pubky-auth/signin and its toasts carry the ids PubkyAuthOtherPubkyToast and PubkyAuthInvalidRequestToast.

actions.action: Open the Profile screen and read this wallet's pubky: tap Share (id "ProfileShare") and read the text preview, then close the share sheet (iOS: tap Copy (id "ProfileCopy") and run xcrun simctl pbpaste)
Set OWN to that pubky without its leading "pubky" prefix; it is 52 characters long
Verify the authorize button (id "PubkyAuthAuthorize") is visible and the profile card (id "PubkyAuthProfile") shows the first and last four characters of OWN
Verify an error toast reads "This request is for 8um7...d1ty, not this wallet's pubky."
Wait 5 seconds, then verify the authorize button (id "PubkyAuthAuthorize") is not visible
Verify the invalid request toast is shown and the authorize button (id "PubkyAuthAuthorize") is not visible
Verify the invalid request toast is shown and the authorize button (id "PubkyAuthAuthorize") is not visible
Verify the invalid request toast is shown and the authorize button (id "PubkyAuthAuthorize") is not visible
